mapper.insert: INSERT INTO writing_library_attempts (user_id, prompt_id, submitted_text, corrected_text, score, criteria, errors, feedback, started_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{promptId}, #{submittedText}, #{correctedText}, #{score}, #{criteriaJson}, #{errorsJson}, #{feedback}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, prompt_id, submitted_text, corrected_text, score, criteria AS criteria_json, errors AS errors_json, feedback, started_at, completed_at FROM writing_library_attempts WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY completed_at DESC
